source_of_truth.active_host_inventory: Supabase public.bigo_sources returned live by the BIGO live pipeline source-registry endpoint on every capture cycle; no fixed host count.
source_of_truth.merge_policy: Deduplicate the live active-registry host IDs with optional BIGO_HOST_IDS and BIGO_VERIFIED_HOST_IDS environment/Actions-secret additions; preserve registry source URLs and use the canonical room URL only as a fallback.
source_of_truth.allowlist_semantics: BIGO_VERIFIED_HOST_IDS is included in the capture inventory; it does not replace active source-registry checks or per-host rights evidence.

capture_method_observed.method: Resolve each host from the live source registry; attempt tokenized BIGO room metadata and Streamlink capture; normalize and QA the media; upload processed video and cover to Vercel Blob; perform public GET and SHA-256 byte-for-byte read-back; optionally archive raw media and metadata to Dropbox and optionally sync Drive.

session_cookie.behavior_when_absent: Attempt public room discovery; record per-host token/authentication failures without blocking other hosts. Configure BIGO_SESSION_COOKIE as a GitHub Actions encrypted secret for authenticated rooms; never print or persist its value.

capture_method_observed.credential_storage: Keep Dropbox OAuth credentials and any optional BIGO session cookie in GitHub Actions encrypted secrets; never store their values in Dropbox manifests or this config.
capture_method_observed.storage: Vercel Blob is the primary public delivery store; Dropbox is optional secondary archival; Google Drive is optional secondary sync.

capture_status_policy.blob_verified: Vercel Blob upload completed and public GET read-back matched the local SHA-256 and byte count
capture_status_policy.captured_not_published: Media is Blob-verified and ingested, but downstream publication is not confirmed or is held by policy
capture_status_policy.published_verified: Downstream platform returns a publication identifier or URL and the post is read back/verified
capture_status_policy.failed_or_offline: Record per-host outcome and continue processing other hosts
